📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter the two points.
  2. Press Calculate.
  3. Read the slope, intercept, equation and see the plotted line.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What does the slope mean?
Rise over run — how many y units the line climbs for each x unit. Positive slopes rise left to right.
Why is slope undefined for vertical lines?
Run is zero (x₂−x₁ = 0), and division by zero is undefined. The line is simply x = constant.
How is the y-intercept found?
Plug one point into y = mx + b and solve: b = y₁ − m·x₁.
